system.description:
You quickly enlarge your main arm by moving the Water in your body. Make a melee Ninjutsu (or Taijutsu) attack. On a hit, you deal [Weapon Damage] + 2d8 and force the target to make a Strength saving throw, being pushed 15 feet and becoming Dazed on a failure.

Hydrofication. This jutsu’s range instead becomes Self (15-Foot Cone), comparing your attack results vs the AC of all creatures in range, applying this jutsu’s effects on a hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by +1d8. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, on a failure, affected creatures also become Bruised. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, on a failure, affected creatures also become Staggered.
